faqs.question: Which files can it read?
faqs.answer: PDF, Word, PowerPoint (with speaker notes), Excel, CSV and text files, plus photos and audio. You can add up to 6 files in one message.

faqs.question: Can it make Word, PowerPoint or Excel files?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can give you PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files to download, and it can email them to you.

faqs.question: Can it read a photo of a page?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send a photo and it reads what is in it, like a printed page, a receipt or a chart.

faqs.question: How does it work out the numbers?
faqs.answer: It runs Python on its own safe computer to clean data, do the maths and draw charts. You can see each step it took.

faqs.question: Where are my files kept?
faqs.answer: Every file you upload or the agent makes is saved in your Library, where you can search and sort them. For chats you don't want saved, use Incognito.

faqs.question: Is it free to start?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sign up with your email and start for free. Top up only when you need more.

plainEnglishHeading: What it can do with your files, in plain English
plainEnglish: Classgrid AI can read your files and do real work with them. You open chat.classgrid.in, drop in a file and say what you want in normal words. It does not just describe the file. It can pull out what matters, change it into something new and hand you back a finished file. It is free to start, and you top up only when you need more.

It reads almost any everyday file. You can give it a PDF, a Word file, a PowerPoint, an Excel sheet, a CSV, a plain text file, a photo or a voice recording. You can add up to 6 files in one message. For slides, it reads the speaker notes too. For voice recordings, it first turns the speech into text.

It can turn a long file into something short. Ask for clear notes, a summary, the key numbers or a list of things to follow up on. You can ask questions about the file, like "when does this contract end?", and it answers from what is inside. If you give it a few files at once, it can compare them for you.

It can make new files you can use straight away. Ask for a report, a letter, a proposal, a slide deck or a sheet. You get a file to download as PDF, Word, PowerPoint or Excel. It can also email the file to you. If something is not right, just ask for a change and it makes a new version.

It is good with spreadsheets. Upload an Excel or CSV file, and it can remove repeated rows, fix messy columns and work out totals and averages. It does the maths by running Python on its own safe computer, so you can see each step. Then it draws clear charts and can put everything into a short PDF report.

It can help you learn or remember anything. From any file, it can make flashcards you flip with a tap, and quick quizzes where you tap an answer and see your score. This works for a new language, a manual at work, a recipe book or any topic you want to know better.

It can plan big goals day by day. Tell it what you want to finish and by when, and it makes a plan with a task for each day, review days and short breaks. You can tick off each day as you go, and a countdown shows how much time is left. If you fall behind, ask it to make a new plan from today.

It works with the places your files already live. Connect Google Drive and it can find and read your files and save new ones there. Connect Gmail or Outlook and it can read your emails, and with Gmail it can read their attachments too. It also works with Notion pages and Google Forms responses.

Your files stay easy to find. Everything you upload and everything the agent makes is saved in your Library, where you can search and sort it. If you don't want a chat saved, open an Incognito chat. In short: drop in a file, and get notes, answers, charts, plans or a brand new file back.
